name: WIN Metals Ltd
summary: WIN Metals Ltd, an Australian-headquartered company established in 2021, specializes in the discovery and development of mineral deposits. The firm primarily targets significant reserves of gold, lithium, and nickel across Australia, with a strong focus on Western Australia. Its portfolio of assets includes the wholly-owned Mt Edwards project, an expansive 240-square-kilometer site in Western Australia that is prospective for both nickel and lithium. Further key holdings consist of the Faraday-Trainline lithium project, located in Widgiemooltha, Western Australia, and the Butchers Creek Gold Project, also situated within Western Australia. The company, which maintains its main office in Perth, officially changed its name from Widgie Nickel Limited to WIN Metals Ltd in July 2024.
